overwritePolicy: never overwrite an existing output; retries use a new filename suffix (e.g. concept_v2.png)
heroLayoutRule: ONE wide row per hero sheet with SEVEN full-body figures on ONE baseline and ONE ruler: H (plain dark-grey neutral silhouette) + 3/4, LEFT, RIGHT, FRONT, BACK on the display body + ALT (the same outfit, props and colours in front-left 3/4 on the other base body). Reference canvas 2172x724, baseline y=640, 1H=400 px; hero crown = 1.0H = 400 px in all six hero figures. No insets, no enlarged 3/4, no 2x2 grid. Body-design state: no VFX, no glow, no particles; lanterns/torches unlit; reliquary niches empty; bier frame at about 50 Burden; flask with salt crust; coal pot or box lid closed and nothing hot. Osric's Lantern (0.12H, one hood flap, no slats) is drawn on every sheet except EX. Tall props (PB frame and pole, BR-A and PS staffs, EX-B spade) stay inside the canvas and below the title band; if they do not fit, shrink ALL seven figures equally, never shorten, bend or crop the prop.
prologueLayoutRule: ONE row on the same ruler: H + six heroes in front-left 3/4 (PB, FL, OS, BR, EX, PS), each on its display body, all in the shared end-of-Prologue look (grey shroud wrap + Gennet's long loose peat-brown coat + canon improvised weapon, mortar dust, barefoot, never nude; PB with a roped bier-board). Act I night palette, no accent colour; no Osric's Lantern.
keyartRule: ONE 16:9 key art: six open hands (PB, FL, OS, BR, EX, PS left to right, canonical order) out of a skull wall in grey mortar, arranged on an arc around one low candle (Gennet's), near darkness; no text.
topdownRule: TOPDOWN_A / TOPDOWN_B: one 3:1 sheet each, two rows of six (PB, FL, OS, BR, EX, PS): game-camera colour row on a flat neutral mid-grey ground, then flat black silhouettes of the same six from the same camera. References: the style image + the six generated concept.png sheets of that letter (identity only). They depend on exactly those six sheets. Run them as a SECOND batch, only after their six sheets pass QA; pass any accepted _v2 sheet with the runner's --ref-map OLD=NEW option.
pilotRule: PB_A was generated once as a layout pilot (art/heroes/PB_pallbearer/vA/concept_pilot.png, 2172x724) and accepted for LAYOUT only: copy ONLY the row order, the baseline position and the label placement; do NOT copy its figure size (its figures are about 480 px tall; here 1H = 400 px). The 11 other hero sheets carry it as an extra LAYOUT-ONLY reference and have no dependency. PB_A is regenerated from its revised prompt to concept.png WITHOUT the pilot attached. If the seven-figure layout fails in other sheets, fall back to six figures (drop ALT) and move ALT to phase 2.
notes: Sizes come from the proposal tables in ASHLAR_HERO_CONCEPT_VI.md (§4.7, §5.7, §6.7, §7.7, §8.8, §9.7); they are production proposals, not canon.
Display body per vocation (concept doc §2.1, presentation only, not a gender lock): PB and EX base body 1, ALT body 2; FL, OS, BR, PS base body 2, ALT body 1.
Hero sheets use neutral studio light and their own palette; no Act I mood reference is attached to any hero job.
Light-only colours (coal red, soul white, lamp amber, ember orange, rime) are listed with usedOnSheet:false and are not drawn on the sheets.
Every palette entry carries its CIE L* value; each design keeps one light mass (L* >= 65) and one dark mass (L* <= 30) (concept doc §2.5).

Production order (concept doc §3): PB, EX, BR, PS, FL, OS. Run the 12 hero sheets, PROLOGUE_LINEUP and CHOICE_HANDS first (any order or in parallel; they need only the existing pilot). TOPDOWN_A and TOPDOWN_B are a second batch, run only after their six sheets pass QA; pass accepted _v2 sheets with --ref-map OLD=NEW (E:/hero-batch/hero_batch.py ignores dependsOn and skips missing references, so the order is manual).
Phase 2 (STATES x6 with three poses each, GEAR x6, HERO_GLOW on the Brinecaller, HERO_LINEUP, lab test on five act grounds + Course + Seamless; concept doc §11.2) has no prompts yet.
Paths use forward slashes; every path is absolute.

PB.text: Signature: ROYAL FUNERAL PURPLE + POLISHED SILVER. Pall cloth, cape and tabard deep royal purple #4B2A6B with a broad silver-grey border band #C9CED6; plate armour polished steel #AEB6BF with dark steel shadows #4E5660 and crisp bright highlights; bier frame and coffin lid pale golden oak #D6BC8C with brass caps and fittings #B8863B; mortar courses clean light stone grey #A39E94; silver coffin nails bright #EEF1F4; leather dark brown #4A3020.

FL.text: Signature: DEEP CRIMSON + EMBER ORANGE. Habit, jerkin and sash deep crimson #8E1F24; linen wraps and shirt clean white linen #EFE6D2; chains blackened iron #2B2B30 with bright steel edge highlights; nun's cuff black #141214; ember-orange glow #FF7A2A ONLY in the coal pot or coal box and on the branding iron's sigil head; ash grey #9A968F.

OS.text: Signature: MIDNIGHT INDIGO + BONE IVORY + COLD SOUL LIGHT. Robes, shawl and coat midnight indigo #1F2547 and ink black #121320; bone ivory #EDE3CB on the wand, finger-bone rings and reliquary; tarnished silver #A8AAB0; apron or capelet pale linen #D9D2C2; soul light cold cyan-white #BFF4FF as small STILL points inside the reliquary niches and one faint grey-white soul wisp (never warm, never gold).

BR.text: Signature: DEEP SEA TEAL + TURQUOISE + SEAFOAM. Robes and smock deep sea teal #11606A shading to turquoise #2FA3A0 with seafoam highlights #CFEDE6; salt crystals pale grey-green #CFDCC8 (never pure white, always irregular and gritty); kelp green #3E5A36; rope sand gold #C9A55C; shells cream #EFE3C8; a few small coral-red accent beads #D9574A; sea water murky teal with foam, never clear blue.

EX.text: Signature: BOTTLE GREEN + AMBER LANTERN LIGHT + BRASS. Coat or jacket deep bottle-green oilcloth #1E4A3A; dark leather #4A2E1E; brass buckles and fittings #C08A3E; silver bolts and spade edge bright #E1E6EA; linen scarf #E3D9C4; hat dark brown felt #3A2A1E with a cream stitched patch #E6DCC2 on the crown (where the open-grave seal was cut away); the class lantern LIT with warm amber light #FFB347 glowing through its five slats.

PS.text: Signature: EMBER FIRE + ICE FROST + ASH WHITE + RED THREAD. Veil ash white-grey #DAD4CA; robe or tunic soot charcoal #2A2420 with bold red-thread embroidered bands #B3332B; red thread braid #B3332B; fur warm brown #7A5A40; frost rime ice blue #BFE3F5 on ONE side (left shoulder and hem); the staff head BURNING with ember-orange flame #FF8A2A and grey ash drifting upward.
